account: Today seems mostly routine from what I have actually seen. During my market walk, several residents said they had no news. I inspected the treasury for town accounts and found 128 emeralds, which I left untouched. I have not received any confirmed urgent business or correspondence. The main unusual difficulty has been arranging my fifteen hundred tea appointment: the appointment book named only 'the neighbour, dockside cottage, east bank,' without a precise address. The secretary took the book and said she would visit the cottages to confirm the host. Since then I have heard her talking or shouting several times without being able to distinguish her words. My shouted request for the address reached her, but I have not heard a clear reply. I do not know what her later calls were about and should not assume an emergency. I crossed the bridge and came to the cottage at (16, -60, 105). It is now 15:19, and the neighbour is waiting two blocks away, with three other residents nearby. This appears consistent with the scheduled tea visit, though I still need to greet the neighbour and confirm. My next office appointment is at 16:30.
